novelty_search.nearest_result: L9H1/H4 are localized has/had contextual reader heads whose donor patch recovers 0.36–0.41; their useful input is distributed over last/period/determiner sources. No head-level path has been tested for is/was.
novelty_search.new_question: Do the exact has/had L9H1/H4 contextual reader heads causally transport is/was temporal state, or does the second task branch through a distinct head set?

population.rows: All 64 is/was rows from the matched-v2 authority already capability-qualified in the pair-support null. Head-patch outcomes are unopened; this is a mechanistic follow-up, not a new population-generalization claim.
population.capability: Recompute two-sided native capability; all eight family/direction cells must retain A/P >=0.85 and C >=0.75 before patch outcomes open.
population.no_rescue: No head, layer, row, threshold, task, or arm change after execution.

operator.site: Layer-9 attention preprojection heads at the final subject query position.

arms.identity_selected: Replace H1/H4 base slices with their exact cached base slices.
arms.donor_selected: Replace H1/H4 base slices with paired donor slices.
arms.donor_complement: Replace the seven complementary head slices with paired donor slices.
arms.donor_all_heads: Replace all nine preprojection slices with paired donor slices.
arms.donor_whole_attention: Replace the complete post-c_proj layer-9 attention output with paired donor output.

bars.instrument: Identity-selected max answer/foil error <=1e-5; donor-all-heads versus donor-whole-attention max error <=1e-5; exact finite 64-row coverage per arm.
bars.full_route: Donor-all-heads A1 and A2 mean recovery >=0.25 and direction fraction >=0.75.
bars.reuse: Donor-selected H1/H4 retain >=0.60 of donor-all-heads mean recovery separately in A1 and A2, have direction fraction >=0.75, and their pooled A mean recovery is strictly greater than the complement's.
bars.selectivity: Selected H1/H4 P and C mean absolute normalized effects <=0.20 of the frozen is/was target scale.
bars.price: Seven forwards/448 examples, five patch arms, zero fit/grid/root/backward/update.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_identity_and: All hashes/capability/coverage/finite checks pass; identity is exact and all-head equals whole-attention routing.
predictions.pred_b_full_l9_attention_route_is_live: All layer-9 heads jointly carry at least 0.25 A1/A2 recovery with direction fraction >=0.75.
predictions.pred_c_q_has_h1_h4_cross_task_reader_reu: H1/H4 retain >=0.60 of the full route in both A families with direction fraction >=0.75.
predictions.pred_d_selected_heads_dominate_complemen: Pooled selected-head A recovery is strictly larger than the complementary seven-head recovery.
predictions.pred_e_selected_head_selectivity_and_exa: Selected P/C effects are <=0.20 and exact seven-forward zero-fit price passes.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: L9H1/H4 are reused contextual reader heads across has/had and is/was.
terminal.null: Instrument and full L9 route pass but reuse, dominance, or selectivity misses; retain distinct task-gated reader paths.
terminal.invalid: Authority, capability, identity, full-route liveness, route agreement, finiteness, coverage, or price fails.
